status: Additional isolated high-FEC tests; production remains unchanged
purpose: Check FEC 3/4, 5/6 and 7/8 throughput with a non-throttling SDR-like input before integration.
baseline: Current continuous Viterbi path from 3b9077b. The old high-FEC block-redecode fallback was already fixed; this is not a comparison with that historical bug.

method.source: File-backed fixed sample clock, 10 ms input chunks, bounded 100 ms software FIFO; downstream stalls drop incoming samples and never move the sample clock.
method.kernel_pipe: The OS pipe and existing decoder buffers add their own bounded capacity; FIFO occupancy and decoder queue/drop counters are recorded separately.
method.clock: OS monotonic scheduling; maximum source clock lateness is measured per run.
method.cpu: Decoder user+system CPU across all threads; excludes source process, GUI and renderer.
method.test_matrix: 3/4, 5/6, 7/8 at 250/500 kHz for 20 s; high-FEC 500 kHz cases twice per variant in reverse order; 1/2 at 500 kHz as control; 7/8 at 500 kHz for 60 s; 7/8 at 500 kHz with noise/fades/drift for 20 s.

source_test.coverage: Byte-exact delivery to a normal reader, and explicit sample loss with a reader stalled for 300 ms while retaining the fixed clock and bounded FIFO.

limits: Synthetic IQ from an independent transmitter encoder; no RF capture or SDR hardware used.
One Ryzen 7 5800H AVX2 host; does not establish headroom on slower machines or under arbitrary competing load.
The longest signal is 60 seconds; this is not a long-duration soak test.
Only QPSK 2K GI 1/32 is measured here. Production integration still needs CPU dispatch/fallback.
